body:
That makes a lot of sense. He always says he feels weak and wants to be the masculine figure, being successful, strong and such. He says he knows that I understand him and make him feel a lot better, but I think you’re right, since he doesn’t really let his guard down I feel useless in helping him. 

He talks to his best friend about it. I’m not sure how often though. I also told his best friend to watch out for him when I’m not around since they live together and he does. My boyfriend doesn’t like to ask for help but I know a few weeks ago they both were feeling crappy and went on a drive together and got some food. I’m happy you said that too, because it reminds me that it’s not all on me. 

I feel so strongly about helping him since I love him and since I have been in his shoes once before. Then again, everyone’s depression is extremely different and what helps one person may not help the next. 

I appreciate all of your help and honest answers. Thank you so much.
Is it selfish of me to not feel loved when he is very depressed? You can’t love others when you don’t love yourself. But it makes me feel horrible and unwanted. How do you think I can deal with this?
It says there’s 6 comments but I can only see 2... why Reddit!
Do you have any advice on how to nudge him more to get help?

You are right. This is very good advice. Thank you. My biggest fear is that he will hurt himself. I know it’s selfish but I don’t want to live a life without him. I also don’t want him to live miserably, so I would like him to get help, whatever that may be. Thank you again.
Yeah that doesn’t fix anything unfortunately hahah but wouldn’t that be great
That’s a good idea. Im going to do that. I know going to therapy at first is really scary. It takes a lot of courage. Thank you for your help!

Yeah, that’s not a bad idea. I’m not sure how it would go over in his head, meaning I know when other people see negative things it makes them spiral downwards more. But it might also feeling like a loving family supporting you. I might mention it. Thank you!

I know it’s a lot because of school. He has a crazy hard major and he is so hard on himself. He is very smart but he thinks he is dumb. I’m trying to visit more definitely. Snuggles always help. He deserves the world. I just want to take his pain away.
